vectors.description: LAB_SPEC 7.2's asom.state/1 example, built from a lender view that carries busy presence inputs: none of them is on the wire
the same view with every presence input different: byte-identical STATE and st (LP-1)
a battery lender that is draining: band 20-49, queue bucket 1, governor QUEUE, no manifest
the queue bucket is min(2, local + peer): 1 + 4 gives 2; the exact battery percentage, loaded models and free memory are absent
an idle AC lender with thermal band 2 and governor HOLD
the spec's example parses and its normal form is itself
a receiver ignores unknown members (user, inflight, loaded, queue.estStartS) and never stores them
a fraction is refused by the JSON profile
an exponent is refused
negative zero is refused
a duplicate member name is refused
truncated JSON
a top-level array is the wrong type
version 2 is not understood
a missing required member (seq)
an fsm outside the closed enum (ERR-LP-3: refused, not mapped to unknown)
thermal band 3 is out of range (0..2)
queue bucket 3 is out of range (0..2)
a negative sampledAgeMs
sampledAgeMs above 60,000 is accepted; the normal form clamps it
a backend outside the closed enum
a power source outside ac|battery|unknown
charging must be a boolean
a battery band outside the closed set
manifest is required (null is allowed, absent is not)
manifest null is allowed
an integer beyond 2^53 - 1 is refused by the JSON profile
a held entry that is not 64 hex characters
held in any order parses; the normal form sorts it
a body digest that is not 43 base64url characters
seq 0 is out of range (the first state has seq 1)
producer-strict: the example conforms
producer-strict: a top-level `user` member is a presence field
producer-strict: `inflight`
producer-strict: `busyForMs` in thermal
producer-strict: `loaded` in engine
producer-strict: `estStartS` in queue
producer-strict: `reason` in availability
producer-strict: an unknown non-presence member
producer-strict: an unknown nested member
producer-strict: a float is refused by the JSON profile first
producer-strict: `queuePos` (removed from INFER_ACCEPT and never a STATE member)
age 0: FRESH
age 5,000: still FRESH
age 5,001: WARM
age 30,000: still WARM
age 30,001: STALE
age 300,000: still STALE
age 300,001: EXPIRED, probe-only
the sender's sampled age adds to the requester's own: 4,000 + 1,000 = 5,000 is FRESH
sampled age is capped at 60,000: a huge value alone gives STALE, never EXPIRED
a closed session's state that is exactly 30,000 old is WARM
a closed session's state older than 30,000 is EXPIRED
seq went backwards: EXPIRED
an equal seq is a repeat, not a reset (ERR-LP-4)
a GOAWAY since the state: EXPIRED
STALE: queue min(2, 1 + 1) = 2, battery band one lower (ge80 to 50-79) on battery, thermal band unchanged (ERR-LP-5)
STALE on AC with quiet fields: nothing changes
WARM passes the received values
EXPIRED yields no fast fields: probe-only
STALE, battery band lt20 stays lt20
STALE, unknown battery band stays unknown
a peer clock that is 10 minutes fast or slow (and 1 ms either way) changes no class: FRESH
a peer clock that is 10 minutes fast or slow (and 1 ms either way) changes no class: WARM
a peer clock that is 10 minutes fast or slow (and 1 ms either way) changes no class: STALE
a peer clock that is 10 minutes fast or slow (and 1 ms either way) changes no class: EXPIRED
